idea-plugin.name: Elasticsearch Client
idea-plugin.description:
Elasticsearch Client is a free, open-source plugin for working with Elasticsearch and OpenSearch clusters directly from IntelliJ IDEA.

  • Multiple connections with Basic, API key and Bearer authentication; secrets are stored in the IDE PasswordSafe.
  • Cluster tree with indices, aliases, data streams and nodes, plus a health indicator.
  • REST console in an editor tab with JSON syntax highlighting, line numbers, auto-indent, request history and saved queries.
  • Data browser in an editor tab with all mapped fields as columns, nested fields, arrays, pagination and Lucene filter.
  • Index and alias actions: info, stats, create, import, copy/reindex, aliases, refresh, flush, force merge, mapping, close and delete.
  • Settings page under Settings | Tools | Elasticsearch Client.

No telemetry. Connection settings stay local, and passwords are kept in the IDE credential store.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 or newer. Licensed under Apache-2.0. Not affiliated with Elastic or JetBrains.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.6.2

  • Fixed FileEditor.getFile() deprecation errors when opening console and data browser tabs.
  • Both editor tabs now explicitly return their virtual file.

0.6.1

  • Marketplace metadata: vendor, description and plugin icon.

0.6.0

  • JSON syntax highlighting in the console request editor, using the IDE color scheme.
  • Line numbers and indent guides; Enter keeps the current indentation and indents inside JSON braces.
  • A Format button pretty-prints the body; request bodies are pretty-printed when a tab opens.

0.5.0

  • REST console opens in an editor tab with a request editor and a response pane.
  • Request DSL: METHOD /path, optional headers and a JSON body; Ctrl+Enter executes.
  • Save consoles and queries from the tab; the tree history and console lists update immediately.

0.4.0

  • Double-click an index or alias to open the data browser in an editor tab.
  • Every mapped field is shown as a table column, including nested fields.
  • Array values, pagination, Lucene filter, column sorting and a document JSON viewer.

0.3.0

  • Full context menu for indices: data browser, REST console, info, stats, create, import, copy, aliases, refresh, flush, force merge, mapping, close, delete.
  • Context menu for aliases: data browser, REST console, alias info, delete alias.
  • Read-only data browser with filter, pagination and document viewer.
  • Manage aliases dialog for a single index.

0.2.0

  • REST console with method, path, headers, body and formatted JSON response.
  • Tree categories: Consoles, Requests (history) and Queries.
  • Save consoles, save query bodies, browse/clear request history.
  • Open an index or alias in the console from the context menu.

0.1.2

  • Fixed "Test Connection" staying at "Connecting..." because the modal dialog blocked the UI callback.

0.1.1

  • Tool window id renamed to "Elasticsearch Client" to avoid a conflict with other Elasticsearch plugins.
